decision: I read the independent assessment and accept its conditions for implementing a required, separately traceable report-supervision hold policy. This permits excluding unresolved supervision without changing clinical annotation states or forcing agreement. It does not approve any concrete hold membership or close a release gate.
conditions: One canonical cell row with overlapping reasons and a deterministic display disposition; unique counts must not sum overlapping reasons.
Rejected proposals remain unresolved unless an actual later reliability disposition exists. Harmless adequate quote variants do not automatically become defects.
All finite worklists and their complements require evidence reuse or explicitly named incomplete-reliability exclusions; no lexical clearance rule and no invented cue-to-target mapping.
Hold lifecycle cannot be silently cleared by later corrections, matching opinions or a changed current annotation.
Actual source-reader identities and scopes remain explicit; copied records do not multiply readers.

Use acyclic bindings: exact case/review/source/context maps, independently approved hold policy decisions, concrete hold registry, all-cell ledger, then QA resolutions and final release. Preserve historical registry snapshots.

Text-intrinsic disputes require exact-report target closure; record-specific evidence defects do not propagate across unrelated pixel or near-report leakage edges. Assess the known near-report edge explicitly.

Non-gold masks are monotone under observed-state, correspondence, semantic-hold and split/technical eligibility. Preserve official gold values, mask1 and evaluation-only split without using gold to select holds.
Require complete finite membership and evidence checks, narrow runtime QA/hold binding, loader/release-boundary checks and meaningful integrity/mask/gradient tests.

Before final release, zero positive or zero negative class in any intended supervised target/train or weak-validation split is a release failure or requires an explicit changed scope. Measure depletion, distinct leakage groups, reason overlaps and selection bias; do not weaken semantic rules to repair counts.
goal_scope: Finish verified data readiness, then research and deliver the competitive model/validation/compute/experiment plan.
